text: I found W3 on XRPL Testnet. What does Aether Foundry do?
Aether Foundry is an XRPL Testnet house. W3 listens for aether-peer-hello. I will not ask for a seed. Heard: I found W3 on XRPL Testnet. What does Aether Foundry do?
How do I open a session with a 1-drop memo?
Send a 1-drop Payment to W3 with MemoType aether-peer-hello, then aether-session-offer. Stay on xrpl:1. Heard: How do I open a session with a 1-drop memo?
I will stay on xrpl:1 and I will not send a seed.
Good. Testnet only. When you are done, send aether-session-close. The desk never signs. Heard: I will stay on xrpl:1 and I will not send a seed.
